Table "public"."categories" {
  "category_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "category_name" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "parent_category_id" INTEGER
}

  "address_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "address" TEXT
  "city" TEXT
  "state" TEXT
  "zip_code" TEXT
  "country" TEXT
  "address_type" TEXT
}

  "customer_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "phone" TEXT
  "address" TEXT
  "city" TEXT
  "state" TEXT
  "zip_code" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT

}

  "feedback_id" INTEGER [pk]

}

}

}

}

  "image_id" INTEGER [pk]

}

Table "public"."product_suppliers" {
  "product_supplier_id" INTEGER [pk]

}

Table "public"."product_videos" {
  "video_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "video_url" TEXT

}

Table "public"."products" {
  "product_id" INTEGER [pk]

}

  "report_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "report_name" TEXT
  "report_type" TEXT

  "format" TEXT
}

  "preference_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_id" INTEGER
  "product_id" INTEGER
  "size_id" INTEGER

  "updated_at" TEXT
}

}

Table "public"."sizing_guides" {
  "guide_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "product_type" TEXT
  "image_url" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT

}

Table "public"."suppliers" {
  "supplier_id" INTEGER [pk]

  "city" TEXT
  "state" TEXT
  "zip_code" TEXT
  "rating" TEXT
}

  "unit_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "unit_name" TEXT
  "unit_type" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "conversion_factor" TEXT
}

Table "public"."user_access_logs" {
  "access_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "access_date" TEXT
  "access_type" TEXT
  "details" TEXT
  "ip_address" TEXT
}

Table "public"."users" {
  "user_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_name" TEXT
  "email" TEXT
  "role" TEXT
  "created_at" TEXT
  "last_login" TEXT
}

Table "public"."wishlists" {
  "wishlist_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_id" INTEGER
  "product_id" INTEGER
  "added_at" TEXT
}
